title: Phoenix and Sorceress
description: A vibrant surreal scene shows a dark-skinned woman in a black robe holding a glowing red-orange orb while standing among potted plants. A massive, intricate dark blue phoenix with cosmic patterns and spread wings dominates the composition, its beak also holding a glowing orb, set against a starry teal sky with comets and floating bubbles.
prompt: A surreal fantasy painting of a dark-skinned sorceress in flowing black robes holding a glowing red orb, standing beside oversized potted plants with citrus slices and bubbling blue cauldrons. A giant intricate dark blue phoenix with cosmic patterns, feathers filled with symbols and constellations, spreads its wings across a starry teal night sky filled with glowing comets and translucent bubbles, vibrant colors, detailed illustration.
